verdict.rationale: First-party docs list a dedicated 'Get Account Payment (ACH) details' capability alongside 'Validate account details' and account-ownership verification, retrieved from accounts the customer links via Connect. This is the product's own instant-verification path to ACH funding data. The evidence is only index-level headings, so the specifics are not shown. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that account and routing numbers (or tokenized equivalents) are returned, explicit positioning as a replacement for micro-deposits, endpoint-level docs or response schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
